question: Flow Nozzle vs Orifice Plate vs Venturi: Which Is Better?
body_html:
Flow nozzle vs orifice plate vs Venturi: all three are ISO 5167 differential pressure flow meters based on Bernoulli, and they differ mainly in geometry, discharge coefficient and permanent pressure loss.

ElementCdPermanent loss
Orifice plate0.595 to 0.64440 to 90% of DP, highest
Flow nozzle0.96 to 0.99530 to 80% of DP
Venturi tube0.984 to 0.995Lowest

The orifice plate is cheapest, the Venturi saves most energy, and the nozzle suits high velocity steam.
